mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_IRIS_* from Data/Player/CW_PantMale03.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:236-246; the helm is CW_HelmMale 3). MU's number 36. Ours is *Male37 by the index-plus-one rule.
why_this_one: Season 2's lower-level sets, missing here (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's): the Fairy Elf's.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (Season 2's sets; 0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.class_level_note: The Fairy Elf's, first class and up: OpenMU's elfClassLevel 1.

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under an iris_ prefix (MU's armor_* and forest_* are too generic to keep): green lacquer plate with pink inlay, a dark skirt, and forest_* her bare skin hung with chain jewellery; level_man033 her head and hair, Red Spirit's.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate; the skirt cloth; forest_* skin (the chains painted on it); forest_legs, a dark strap, leather; level_man033 hair.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain's arms for MODEL_IRIS_ARMOR, PANTS and GLOVES (ZzzObject.cpp:7731-7763) draw one mesh alone when the skin is hidden, else the whole body: no glow, no chrome pass.
